details: Bitcoin's price dropped significantly, falling below key support levels, following the release of hotter-than-expected US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for September. This data reignited concerns among investors about the Federal Reserve implementing more aggressive interest rate hikes, leading to widespread liquidations across the crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Plunges as Hot US Inflation Sparks Rate Hike Fears

details: Ethereum spot exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced net outflows on October 14, with BlackRock's ETHA fund notably seeing a $110 million outflow. Adding to the negative sentiment, VanEck withdrew its application for a Lido Staked Ethereum ETF, reducing future investment product options for US investors and contributing to downward pressure on ETH's price.
title: Ethereum ETFs Face Outflows Amid VanEck's Staked ETH ETF Withdrawal

details: The "Clarity Act," a significant piece of US crypto market structure legislation, has stalled in the Senate, leaving the legislative allocation of SEC/CFTC jurisdiction unresolved. This legislative setback coincided with the departure of Patrick Witt, the executive director for the President's Council of Advisors for Digital Assets, from his White House crypto role, further contributing to an uncertain regulatory environment for digital assets in the United States.
title: US Crypto Regulatory Uncertainty Grows as Clarity Act Stalls and Advisor Exits
